name: Bonsai 27B
description: Bonsai 27B is a 27B-class multimodal model based on Qwen3.6 27B, optimized for on-device and local agentic workflows. It is available in two highly compressed variants: a 5.9 GB Ternary variant (1.71 bits/weight) and a 3.9 GB 1-bit variant (1.125 bits/weight), allowing it to fit within the memory budget of everyday laptops and phones (like the iPhone 17 Pro).
keyFeatures: Ternary (1.71 effective bits) and 1-bit (1.125 effective bits) variants with no higher-precision escape hatches
Multimodal with a compact 4-bit vision tower
Supports multi-step reasoning, structured tool calls, and computer-use agentic loops
Native support on Apple devices via MLX and NVIDIA GPUs via CUDA
